nodes.description: Public payable sale function of AssetBackingCryptoCurrency; validates the sale window with now, computes the token amount and bonus, then mints tokens to the caller.
Fallback function that accepts ether and forwards execution to buyTokens().
Public mint(to, amount) entry point (CappedToken/MintableToken); enforces the cap and minting permission before creating tokens.
Caller-controlled address; used as the purchase beneficiary and the receiver of newly minted tokens.
Block timestamp referenced as now in the sale window checks and bonus condition; miner-influenceable.
Arithmetic expression msg.value * 1000000000000000000 / tokenPrice used to derive the token amount; unchecked raw multiplication/division.
Arithmetic expression amount + bonus used as the minted quantity; unchecked raw addition.
uint256 tokenPrice = 0.01 ether; used as the divisor when converting ether into tokens.
uint256 startDate = 1530518400; lower bound of the token sale window.
uint256 endDate = 1533024000; upper bound of the token sale window.
uint256 public cap = 30000000000000000000000000; maximum total supply enforced by mint.
address public owner inherited from Ownable; gate for minting permission and administrative functions.
mapping(address => uint256) private balances; token balances updated by _mint.
uint256 private totalSupply_; total token supply increased by _mint and bounded by cap.
Internal _mint(account, amount) from StandardToken; increases totalSupply_ and the recipient balance and emits Transfer.
address _to parameter of mint; recipient of newly minted tokens.
uint256 _amount parameter of mint; quantity of tokens to create.
uint256 local bonusPercentage (15, or 0 when now > 1533024000); scales the bonus token amount.
uint256 local amount derived from msg.value * 1e18 / tokenPrice.
uint256 local bonus = amount * bonusPercentage / 100.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted caller whose address becomes the sale beneficiary and later the mint receiver.
Timestamp dependency: require(now >= startDate) and require(now < endDate) gate buyTokens on block.timestamp.
The bonus branch condition if (now > 1533024000) makes the bonus amount depend on block.timestamp.
startDate is compared against block.timestamp to decide whether the sale is open.
endDate is compared against block.timestamp to decide whether the sale is still open.
tokenPrice is the divisor of the token amount computation msg.value * 1e18 / tokenPrice.
Result of the unchecked multiplication/division is assigned to the local variable amount.
Local amount is an operand of the unchecked addition amount + bonus.
Local bonusPercentage feeds the bonus computation that is added to amount.
Local bonus contributes to the unchecked addition amount + bonus.
The unchecked sum amount + bonus is forwarded as the mint quantity.
buyTokens calls mint(msg.sender, amount + bonus) after emitting TokenPurchase.
msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient, allowing the caller to obtain tokens without owner permission checks in the derived path.
cap is compared with totalSupply().add(_amount) to bound the minted amount.
owner is checked against msg.sender by hasMintPermission before minting.
mint delegates to the internal _mint implementation after the cap check.
_mint increases totalSupply_ by the minted amount.
_mint credits the recipient entry in the balances mapping.
Parameter _to flows into mint as the token recipient.
Parameter _amount flows into mint as the token quantity.
The payable fallback function unconditionally forwards to buyTokens().

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only carries the recipient address into the mint function and has no independent security meaning.
The _amount parameter only carries the mint quantity into the mint function and is bounded by cap inside it.
bonusPercentage is a temporary local of buyTokens selected by the timestamp condition before scaling the bonus.
amount is the direct result of the unchecked expression msg.value * 1000000000000000000 / tokenPrice.
bonus is a transient intermediate that only feeds the unchecked sum amount + bonus.
